meta.note: Visual defaults for the Figma plugin data-driven builders — every CoreXxxStyle the AST reader discovered, walked generically (no per-component hand-written extraction). v3 adds per-component section/axes/docs/examples on top of the byte-stable v2 fields/variants/sizes.

docs.description: 아코디언/접기 컴포넌트
